probes.title: Device identity
probes.purpose: Describe the claimed device and operating-system build for consistency checks.

probes.title: Hardware
probes.purpose: Collect coarse hardware, display, memory, battery, and device-class observations.
probes.notes: Detailed battery/power and NFC state are Android-only. Storage and uptime are Android-only because the corresponding iOS APIs require additional declarations.

probes.title: Installed fonts
probes.purpose: Produce a platform-local digest of installed font names for consistency analysis.
probes.notes: Digests are comparable only within the same platform and are not persistent device identifiers.

probes.title: OS integrity
probes.purpose: Expose root, jailbreak, emulator, debugger, hook, and boot-integrity observations.
probes.notes: Returns explainable raw evidence. Weak Android build markers and device-farm markers are reported but do not set isEmulator without a stronger emulator observation.

probes.title: Frida port scan
probes.purpose: Check the local Frida server default port as an active instrumentation signal.

probes.title: iOS fork jailbreak test
probes.purpose: Test whether the iOS process can fork outside the normal application sandbox.
probes.notes: Disabled until stability is validated on a representative physical-device lab.

probes.title: Network context
probes.purpose: Describe connectivity, VPN, proxy, interfaces, local addresses, and traffic counters.
permissions: Uses ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE only when already declared by the host application
probes.notes: Active-link details require host-declared ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE. Missing permission/read failures are omitted; no DNS lookup or network request is performed. SSID and BSSID are normally absent.

probes.title: Telephony context
probes.purpose: Collect opportunistic carrier, SIM, roaming, and network-country observations.
permissions: Uses READ_PHONE_STATE only when already granted to the host application for SIM count
probes.notes: No phone-state permission is requested. IMEI is intentionally unavailable to normal applications.

probes.title: Locale
probes.purpose: Describe locale, timezone, formatting, and keyboard-language consistency.

probes.title: Geolocation context
probes.purpose: Read permission state and an already-available last-known location without prompting.
permissions: Uses only location permission already granted to the host application
probes.notes: The SDK never requests location permission or starts an active location update. mockLocationAppsFound is reserved but not populated because broad package enumeration is prohibited.

probes.title: Media, Bluetooth, accessibility, and known apps
probes.purpose: Expose media-route, paired-device count, accessibility, and finite known-app observations.
permissions: Uses BLUETOOTH_CONNECT only when already granted to the host application
probes.notes: App visibility is limited to an audited finite list; QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES is not requested. iOS mirroring uses UIScreen.mirroredScreen rather than external-screen presence.

probes.title: GPU benchmark
probes.purpose: Collect GPU identity and bounded workload timing for device-class consistency analysis.
probes.notes: Disabled by default because it is high entropy and requires device-lab calibration.

probes.title: Audio latency
probes.purpose: Collect coarse audio pipeline properties for device-class consistency analysis.
probes.notes: Disabled by default pending representative device-lab calibration.

probes.title: Host application
probes.purpose: Describe the host app, install source, granted permissions, and package delivery shape.
probes.notes: Android install-source values describe the host package only and remain untrusted installer-supplied observations. getTaskAllowEntitlement is reserved but not populated because the public iPhoneOS headers do not expose a supported entitlement lookup API.

probes.title: Device security posture
probes.purpose: Expose coarse lock, biometric availability, trusted-time, provisioning, and security-update observations.
probes.notes: Reports capability/state only and never displays an authentication prompt or reads biometric material. iOS Lockdown Mode is not collected: its only read path (NSUserDefaults) is an Apple Required-Reason API category and this module declares none.

probes.title: Transaction safety
probes.purpose: Collect point-in-time remote-control, screen-capture, accessibility, lock, and call-state observations.
permissions: Android 14 screenshot observation requires host-declared DETECT_SCREEN_CAPTURE
Android 15 screen-recording visibility requires host-declared DETECT_SCREEN_RECORDING
probes.notes: Ships disabled until physical-device calibration. Android UI observation starts lazily on the first collection; collect once when the protected flow starts and again immediately before its action. The library declares neither capture permission and never prompts.

probes.title: React Native runtime
probes.purpose: Describe the JavaScript engine and active React Native architecture.

probes.title: Runtime timing profile
probes.purpose: Measure bounded JS event-loop, native clock, and JS-to-native call timing distributions.
probes.notes: Disabled by default because timing is noisy, high entropy, and requires physical-device calibration.

probes.title: Numeric runtime consistency
probes.purpose: Compare deterministic integer and floating-point behavior across JavaScript and native runtimes.
probes.notes: Disabled by default; returns comparison aggregates rather than raw stable identifiers or a verdict.
